name: Caral civilization, the oldest in America
summary: Immersive experience "Pututus Ceremonial Hall". Immersive virtual reality experience - VR inspired by the values ​​and social history of the Caral Civilization, the oldest in America, of the «Pututus Ceremonial Hall» located on the top of the Main Public Building, upper part of «Peñico, City of Social Integration», during the Early Formative 1 (1800-1500 BC). Peñico is one of the 25 urban centers identified in the Supe Valley, 30 years ago, by the team of professionals led by the Peruvian archaeologist Dr.
